players.bio: William Monroe Cook (born January 7, 1999) is an American professional baseball first baseman and outfielder for the Pittsburgh Pirates of Major League Baseball (MLB).

Brandon Michael Eisert (born January 19, 1998) is an American professional baseball pitcher for the Chicago White Sox of Major League Baseball (MLB). He has previously played in MLB for the Toronto Blue Jays. He made his MLB debut in 2024.
Braxton Ashcraft (born October 5, 1999) is an American professional baseball pitcher for the Pittsburgh Pirates of Major League Baseball (MLB).

Bryan Patrick Reynolds (born January 27, 1995) is an American professional baseball outfielder for the Pittsburgh Pirates of Major League Baseball (MLB). Reynolds played college baseball for the Vanderbilt Commodores, and the San Francisco Giants selected him with the 59th pick in the 2016 Major League Baseball draft. The Giants traded him to the Pirates in 2018.

Roy Reuben "Bubba" Chandler IV (born September 14, 2002) is an American professional baseball pitcher for the Pittsburgh Pirates of Major League Baseball (MLB). He made his MLB debut in 2025. Early life Chandler was born on September 14, 2002, to parents Ruben and Bobbi. He was given the moniker "Bubba" as a baby by his older sisters.
Carmen Alexander Mlodzinski (muh-jin-ski; born February 19, 1999) is an American professional baseball pitcher for the Pittsburgh Pirates of Major League Baseball (MLB).

Donald Thomas Kelly (born February 15, 1980) is an American former professional baseball utility player and current coach. He is the manager of the Pittsburgh Pirates of Major League Baseball (MLB). He played in MLB for the Pirates, Detroit Tigers, and Miami Marlins. Kelly played every position on the field in the major leagues, including pitcher.

Esmerlyn Valdez (born January 27, 2004) is a Dominican professional baseball outfielder for the Pittsburgh Pirates of Major League Baseball (MLB). Nicknamed the Magician, he made his MLB debut in 2026. Career On January 15, 2021, Valdez signed with the Pittsburgh Pirates organization as an international free agent. He made his professional debut with the Dominican Summer League Pirates.
Samuel Evan Sisk (born April 23, 1997) is an American professional baseball pitcher for the Kansas City Royals of Major League Baseball (MLB).

Henry Davis (born September 21, 1999) is an American professional baseball right fielder and catcher for the Pittsburgh Pirates of Major League Baseball (MLB). He played college baseball for the University of Louisville. Davis was the first overall selection in the 2021 MLB draft, and made his MLB debut in 2023.

Hunter Harkins Barco (born December 15, 2000) is an American professional baseball pitcher for the Pittsburgh Pirates of Major League Baseball (MLB). Amateur career Barco attended The Bolles School in Jacksonville, Florida, where he began playing varsity baseball in the eighth grade.

Isaac Gerald Mattson (born July 14, 1995) is an American professional baseball pitcher for the Pittsburgh Pirates of Major League Baseball (MLB). He has previously played in MLB for the Baltimore Orioles. On November 20, 2020, Mattson was added to the 40-man roster. On May 3, 2021, Mattson was promoted to the major leagues for the first time.

Jacob Jesus Gonzalez (born May 30, 2002) is an American professional baseball infielder for the Pittsburgh Pirates of Major League Baseball (MLB). He has previously played in MLB for the Chicago White Sox. Gonzalez played college baseball for the Ole Miss Rebels and was selected by the White Sox in the first round of the 2023 MLB draft. He made his MLB debut in 2026 with the White Sox.

Jacob Thomas Mangum (born March 8, 1996) is an American professional baseball outfielder for the Pittsburgh Pirates of Major League Baseball (MLB). He has previously played in MLB for the Tampa Bay Rays. Mangum played college baseball for the Mississippi State Bulldogs.
Jared Keith Jones (born August 6, 2001) is an American professional baseball pitcher for the Pittsburgh Pirates of Major League Baseball (MLB). He made his MLB debut in 2024.
Jared Robert Triolo (born February 8, 1998) is an American professional baseball third baseman for the Pittsburgh Pirates of Major League Baseball (MLB). He made his MLB debut in 2023.

Jhostynxon Alirio García (/dʒoʊˈstɪnsoʊn/ joh-STIN-sohn, born December 11, 2002) nicknamed "The Password", is a Venezuelan professional baseball outfielder for the Boston Red Sox of Major League Baseball (MLB). He signed with the Red Sox as an international free agent in 2019, and made his MLB debut in 2025.
Lake David Bachar (born June 3, 1995) is an American professional baseball pitcher for the Miami Marlins of Major League Baseball (MLB).

Lucas Allen Weaver (born August 21, 1993) is an American professional baseball pitcher for the New York Yankees of Major League Baseball (MLB). He has previously played in MLB for the St. Louis Cardinals, Arizona Diamondbacks, Kansas City Royals, and Cincinnati Reds.
Mason Jack Montgomery (born June 17, 2000) is an American professional baseball pitcher for the Tampa Bay Rays of Major League Baseball (MLB).

Mitch Thomas Keller (born April 4, 1996) is an American professional baseball pitcher for the Pittsburgh Pirates of Major League Baseball (MLB). Amateur career Keller was drafted by the Pittsburgh Pirates in the second round of the 2014 Major League Baseball draft out of Xavier High School in Cedar Rapids, Iowa. He signed with the Pirates on June 14, 2014 for a signing bonus worth $1,000,000.

Nicholas Joseph Gonzales (born May 27, 1999) is an American baseball second baseman for the Pittsburgh Pirates of Major League Baseball (MLB). He was selected seventh overall by the Pirates in the 2020 MLB draft and he made his MLB debut in 2023.

Nicholas Anthony Yorke (born April 2, 2002) is an American professional baseball infielder for the Pittsburgh Pirates of Major League Baseball (MLB). He was selected 17th overall by the Boston Red Sox in the 2020 MLB draft and was traded to the Pirates in 2024, making his debut the same year.
Oneil Cruz (born October 4, 1998) is a Dominican professional baseball player for the Pittsburgh Pirates. He made his MLB debut in 2021.

Paul David Skenes (born May 29, 2002) is an American professional baseball pitcher for the Pittsburgh Pirates of Major League Baseball (MLB). He made his MLB debut in 2024. Skenes played college baseball for the Air Force Falcons and LSU Tigers.

Rafael Flores (born November 7, 2000) is an American professional baseball catcher for the Pittsburgh Pirates of Major League Baseball (MLB). He made his MLB debut in 2025. Career Flores attended Katella High School in Anaheim, California, and Rio Hondo College. He went unselected in the 2022 MLB draft.

Ronny Oliver Simon (born April 17, 2000) is a Dominican professional baseball infielder for the Pittsburgh Pirates of Major League Baseball (MLB). He has previously played in MLB for the Miami Marlins. He made his MLB debut in 2025.

Ryan Patrick O'Hearn (born July 26, 1993) is an American professional baseball first baseman for the Baltimore Orioles of Major League Baseball (MLB). He was drafted by the Kansas City Royals in the eighth round of the 2014 Major League Baseball Draft. He signed and spent 2014 with the Idaho Falls Chukars, posting a .361 batting average with 13 home runs and 54 RBIs in 64 games.

Spencer Elliott Horwitz (born November 14, 1997) is an American professional baseball first baseman and second baseman for the Pittsburgh Pirates of Major League Baseball (MLB). He has previously played in MLB for the Toronto Blue Jays. The Blue Jays selected him in the 24th round of the 2019 MLB draft, and he made his MLB debut in 2023.

Thomas Hinson Harrington (born July 12, 2001) is an American professional baseball pitcher for the Pittsburgh Pirates of Major League Baseball (MLB). He played college baseball for the Campbell Fighting Camels.

Tsung-Che Cheng (Chinese: 鄭宗哲; pinyin: Zhèng Zōngzhé; born July 26, 2001) is a Taiwanese professional baseball infielder for the Pittsburgh Pirates of Major League Baseball (MLB). He signed with the Pirates as an international free agent in 2019 and made his MLB debut in 2025.

Tyler Callihan (born June 22, 2000) is an American professional baseball second baseman for the Cincinnati Reds of Major League Baseball (MLB). He made his MLB debut in 2025. Amateur career Callihan attended Providence School in Jacksonville, Florida, where he began starting on their varsity baseball team as an eighth grader. In 2018, as a junior, he hit .440 with 11 home runs.

Yohan Manuel Ramírez (born May 6, 1995) is a Dominican professional baseball pitcher. He has previously played in MLB for the Seattle Mariners, Cleveland Guardians, Pittsburgh Pirates and Chicago White Sox. On December 12, 2019, Ramírez was selected by the Seattle Mariners in the 2019 Rule 5 draft.
